data.exact_reserve_text: An overall improvement of GBP 16.9 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year. Improvements comprised of GBP 4.9 million on fire and other damage to property, GBP 3.8 million on marine, aviation and transport, GBP 2.7 million on energy, GBP 2.8 million on reinsurance acceptances and GBP 2.5 million on third party liability.

named_events.loss_description: It is estimated that these four combined will contribute US$18 million of net loss to the syndicate.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 the syndicate had gross claims outstanding of GBP 264.389m. During 2017 there was an overall release on prior years' reserves of GBP 16.9m (6.4% of opening gross claims), driven by favourable development across several lines: Property (fire and other damage to property) GBP 4.9m, Marine GBP 3.8m, Energy GBP 2.7m, Reinsurance acceptances GBP 2.8m and Casualty (third party liability) GBP 2.5m. The movement is described as improvements on prior years and is reported in the Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding note.
raw_causal_phrases: An overall improvement of GBP 16.9 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year.

Improvements comprised of GBP 4.9 million on fire and other damage to property, GBP 3.8 million on marine, aviation and transport, GBP 2.7 million on energy, GBP 2.8 million on reinsurance acceptances and GBP 2.5 million on third party liability.
Reserves in respect of the 2014 and prior years of account continue to improve and develop satisfactorily, generating a surplus of GBP 13 million as at 31 December 2017.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development taken from the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' narrative which reports a GBP 16.9m improvement; narrative does not explicitly label the figure 'gross' but the movement note context and breakdown by insurance classes indicate these are gross improvements. Some event loss figures in the report are given in USD (e.g. US$18m combined net loss for 2017 hurricanes) and have not been converted to GBP; where only USD figures are quoted the GBP numeric field is left null and the USD amount is referenced in the description. Claims development triangle is present and used as cross-check; RITC does not appear to distort the triangle for the included years.
